what: On a dark-ink panel a small wordmark floats up after .3s over 1.2s (cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)). Once loading finishes and the panel has been visible for 1.1s or more, it rests .4s, then the wordmark sets in .7s and the panel lifts away .2s later over 1s. .76s after the lift begins, the hero panel (drop) settles from the top of the document into place in 1.1s, and the screen-width wordmark (rise) rises in 1.6s from below the band’s bottom, hidden by its band (both cubic-bezier(.33,0,.2,1)) — a hero where the two interlock in the middle

options.[data-fx-part=sheet]: (If present) Full-screen loader panel — the [data-fx-part inside=mark] rises and fades. To cover from the first image, <head> Attach is-fx-preload to html in
options.[data-fx-part=drop]: Panel that settles into place from the top of the page (Hero)
options.[data-fx-part=band] · [data-fx-part=rise: A band covering the wordmark and the wordmark rising from inside it
options.enter: Time until the wordmark lights up after the panel settles (ms), default 300
options.min: Minimum time to keep the panel visible (ms), default 1100
options.hold: Pause (ms) after loading finishes before the panel lifts away, default 400
options.slide: Time from when the panels start to peel away until the settle and rise turn on (ms), default 760
options.curtain: Time from the panel starting to sweep away until it is erased (ms), default 1250
options.drop: Duration of hero settling down (s), default 1.1
options.settle: Extra wait time (ms) when the transition end isn’t received, default 600
options.--fx-mark-in · --fx-mark-out · --fx-shee: Panel wordmark on·off, panel retract length (via style), defaults 1.2s · .7s · 1s
options.fx:intro-start · fx:intro-done: Events fired by the element at start and end — stop smooth scrolling, then turn it back on (start) at the end

note: While the plate is present, overflow:hidden is applied to html. The original stops lenis every 150ms and at the end does scrollTo(0) and start — we receive this by events and do the same thing
